name.full: MS Skill Mastery - Learning Roadmap Research & HTML Generator

description.short: Research a technology and get a polished HTML learning roadmap
description.full: Educational Cowork plugin that researches any technology or skill (e.g. React, Azure Kubernetes Service) using the Microsoft Learn MCP Server, builds a structured learning roadmap with staged topics, resources and time estimates, then renders it into a visually consistent, self-contained HTML page using a bundled reusable template.

agentConnectors.description: Access to Microsoft's official documentation for research and content generation. Provides search and fetch capabilities for Microsoft Learn articles, modules, and learning paths used to build technology skill roadmaps.
